commit_message: Add ACP integration and execution routing seam
pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate the common ACP transport, AgentHost bridge, and provider adapters
- add a provider-neutral Registry/Bridge composition seam for AI Studio
- add process-local stable-selection execution routing with explicit Legacy rollback and fail-closed ACP availability
- preserve stable user-visible AI identities and Agent Host authority

## Integration

The next slice attaches this seam to Ask/Build execution, then benchmark migration and final lockfile/validation follow on this Draft branch.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required after this slice; final integrated-head validation remains authoritative.
